resources.string: Original audio stays here until a saved document contains it. Adding it is an unsaved edit. Keep it for later if you are unsure.
The original recording was kept. Open recording recovery to choose what to do.
The recording details are unreadable. They have been kept; any unbound audio is listed separately.
The original audio is missing or empty. Its recovery details have been kept.
Open a document to add this audio. A changed document cannot receive an older recovery request.
This recording ID is already in the document. The original is kept until the saved audio is verified.
This audio was previously added. It may have been undone or removed; restore it only if you want it back.
The original document cannot be verified. You can add the audio separately without linking existing ink.
These details belong to another document or recording. You can add the audio separately.
The audio is ready to restore with its original ink association.
